name: FAQ, yes or no
description: Each question shows its short answer up front as a pill with an icon: yes, no or it depends. The row opens for the explanation.

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.default: Yes, no or it depends, then the detail if you want it. From the mechanics at Cog & Chain on Gloucester Road.

itemFields.name: answer
itemFields.label: Explanation
itemFields.default: Card, phone and cash are all fine.

default.question: Do you repair e-bikes?
default.answer: Bosch, Shimano Steps and Brose systems, including diagnostics and firmware updates. For other motors we can still do everything mechanical.

default.question: Do I need to book?
default.answer: Punctures, brake pads and gear tweaks are done while you wait. For a full service, book a day online so we can keep a stand free.

default.question: Can you fix it the same day?
default.answer: Drop it off before 10 am and most repairs are ready by 5 pm. If we have to order a part, we tell you before we start, with a price.

default.question: Do you sell new bikes?
default.answer: We only repair and refurbish. There is a rack of serviced second-hand bikes from £140, each with a three-month guarantee.

default.question: Is there a guarantee on repairs?
default.answer: Twelve months on labour, and the maker's warranty on parts. If something we fixed works loose, bring it back and we put it right for free.

default.question: Will you fit parts I bought online?
default.answer: Happily, at our normal labour rate. We cannot guarantee parts we did not supply, and we will say so if one looks wrong for your bike.
